notes.title: Non-Game Update. Trading Cards released
notes.content:
Hello dear players,

Since the publisher of app is changed and we are new owners of app, we would like to inform that we added Trading Cards in Strange Night, it's just a small "thank you" for all players who supported this project.

Thanks again

notes.title: Update (Operating time)
notes.content:
Hi dear players, 

we Have Been monitoring your comments on the forums and made some minor corrections in the game to fix your problems .This update the player has the option to start the game at any time. the need to change the system time used in previous mechanical. (We will keep updating any Reported error) .thanks!
